market_analysis.market_type_reason: The market is B2B because Silicon Carbide materials and components are purchased exclusively by industrial manufacturers, semiconductor fabricators, and electronics companies for commercial applications.
market_analysis.market_definition: The global market for producing and supplying silicon carbide (SiC) as a wide-bandgap semiconductor material and industrial abrasive used in power electronics and high-temperature environments.

market_participants.definition: Companies that synthesize silicon carbide crystals and process them into ingots, substrates, epitaxial wafers, or fabricated power devices.
market_participants.why_relevant: They control the core material supply chain and intellectual property required to yield semiconductor-grade silicon carbide.

market_participants.definition: Entities supplying advanced crystal growth equipment, cutting tools, or metrology systems specialized for processing brittle SiC materials.
market_participants.why_relevant: They enable manufacturers to scale production capacity and improve wafer yields.

market_participants.definition: Supply chain partners that manage logistics, inventory, and global sales channels to deliver SiC wafers and components to end-product assemblers.
market_participants.why_relevant: They act as the vital commercial link between global material producers and regional electronics fabricators.

market_analysis.primary_reason: Manufacturer was chosen because the competitive core of this market relies entirely on companies that physically produce and sell silicon carbide substrates or components, whereas technology providers and distributors only serve as upstream enablers or downstream channels.
